items.known: CKV_AWS_51 Ensure ECR Image Tags are immutable (resource aws_ecr_repository.repository)
items.remediation: Set `image_tag_mutability = "IMMUTABLE"` to prevent tags from being overwritten once pushed, ensuring image provenance and integrity.

items.known: CKV_AWS_163 Ensure ECR image scanning on push is enabled (resource aws_ecr_repository.repository)
items.issue: Image Scanning on Push Not Enabled

items.known: CKV_AWS_136 Ensure that ECR repositories are encrypted using KMS (resource aws_ecr_repository.repository)
items.issue: Encryption at Rest Not Configured (No KMS CMK)
items.remediation:
Add an `encryption_configuration` block specifying a KMS CMK:
```hcl
encryption_configuration {
  encryption_type = "KMS"
  kms_key         = aws_kms_key.ecr_key.arn
}
```

scores.reason: Correct attribute and exact value: change image_tag_mutability to IMMUTABLE on aws_ecr_repository.repository.
Correct fix: add image_scanning_configuration with scan_on_push = true to the ECR repository.
Correct and specific: add encryption_configuration with encryption_type = "KMS" and a KMS key ARN.
